title: Is there any specific clothing my child should wear for Occupational Therapy sessions at Pinnacle?
metaTitle: Clothing Guide for Occupational Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Understand the recommended clothing for your child during Occupational Therapy sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network, to ensure they have comfortable movements.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms, we want to ensure your child is at ease during each session of Occupational Therapy. We recommend that your little one wears comfortable, free-flowing clothing that doesn't restrict movement. And for sessions where we might be focusing on balance and motor skills, open-toed shoes or being barefoot is generally best, to encourage natural movements.
